description: pthread_cond_broadcast with multiple waiters (M6-D). userspace/ctests/musl_cond.c blocks 3 worker threads in pthread_cond_wait and broadcasts once; all 3 must wake and join. This deadlocked before: the ordered wake chain uses FUTEX_REQUEUE, an unmapped sentinel (-ENOSYS no-op) on Dunit, so predecessors never woke. Fixed by waking instead of requeueing in the musl fork (src/thread/pthread_cond_timedwait.c). Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_cond_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: all three waiters woke from a single pthread_cond_broadcast (no requeue deadlock)
main joined all workers — no hang

forbidden.why: not all waiters woke from the broadcast
